overview: Lethal Ridge is the most dangerous traversal zone in Mons Letalis.
details: Gravity shears, collapsing shelves, and pulse fractures make movement unpredictable. Rockhoppers ambush travelers from unstable ledges.
hooks: A gravity shear cuts across the ridge, flinging debris sideways.
A stone shelf collapses, revealing a pulse cavern.
Rockhoppers gather near a fracture line.
A geomantic pulse destabilizes the ridge.
